data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
主句：Paleontologists (主语) have argued (谓语) for a long time (状语) that... (宾语从句)。
宾语从句主干：the demise (主语) was caused (谓语) by climatic alterations (宾语/状语)。
### 【主谓一致】
Paleontologists是复数，have argued正确。demise是单数，was caused正确。
### 【动词时态与原形】
have argued: 现在完成时，表示从过去持续到现在的影响或状态。
was caused: 一般过去时被动语态。
### 【从句剖析】
that引导的宾语从句，作argued的宾语。
### 【非谓语动词】
associated with...: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰climatic alterations。
resulting from...: 现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰slow changes。
### 【代词指代】
无代词。

data.text: Their calculations show that the impact kicked up a dust cloud that cut off sunlight for several months, inhibiting photosynthesis in plants; decreased surface temperatures on continents to below freezing; caused extreme episodes of acid rain; and significantly raised long-term global temperatures through the greenhouse effect.
